title: Fundraiser launched for McHenry County teens killed in suspected drunk driving accident - NewsBreak
text: MCHENRY COUNTY, Ill. ( WGN ) — A McHenry County family struck by tragedy is asking for the public’s help to bury two of their family members after they were victims in a suspected drunk driving accident. Elvia Gonzales, the aunt of 19-year-old Perla Rubi Tejada and 14-year-old Anthony Alexander Hernandez, said their family is remembering the two for how happy and playful they were. “Recordandolos como ellos eran alegres, jugetones,” Gonzales said. Tejada had just graduated high school and enrolled in cosmetology. Family said Hernandez had just graduated middle school, and was looking forward to starting high school. Tejada and Hernandez were headed home after having dinner and spending time with friends and family Monday night. As they drove through the intersection of Richmond and McCullom Lake Roads, they were hit head-on by a red Audi, throwing Anthony from the vehicle in the process. Both were pronounced dead when authorities arrived on the scene. “Si pido justicia que esa persona page contra la ley,” Gonzales said. Through tears, Gonzales said she was in disbelief and hoped it was an error as she passed by the scene of the crash after she received the call. She said reality set in when she saw their car. Now, a memorial with their pictures, candles and flowers sits outside the family’s home. Each night since the crash, their family has gathered at 7 p.m. to pray over a rosary. Gonzales has started a GoFundMe Page to help Tejada and Hernandez’s family with funeral expenses. A fundraiser will also be held on Aug. 9 in McHenry County at the Green Street Cafe on North Green Street with the same goal. The fundraiser takes place from 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. For the latest news, weather, sports, and streaming video, head to WGN-TV.
